title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI gating and metrics integration
author: Priya Raman
description: Motivation: Add a deterministic CI gating step that runs prompt-set regressions for core prompt families and blocks merges when quality metrics drop beyond configured thresholds. This integrates the eval-harness metrics pipeline into the repo-level CI (GitHub Actions) and surfaces failures as a required check. Changes include: 1) a new GitHub Actions workflow (eval-prompt-regression.yml) that boots a lightweight runner, pulls the latest model artifacts from the test registry, and runs the selected prompt-sets; 2) an evaluation gating script (eval-harness/ci/regression_gate.py) that computes the configured metrics (exact-match, BLEU-ish heuristic, embed-sim) and compares them to stored baselines; 3) baseline management helpers (eval-harness/ci/baseline_store.py) to fetch/update per-model baselines stored in S3; 4) small updates to the prompt catalog to tag the canonical prompt families and control sampling for CI runs; 5) integration tests that mock the registry and S3 to make the workflow hermetic for PR validation. Checklist: - [x] add workflow and gating script - [x] publish metric schemas and thresholds - [x] add unit tests for baseline helpers - [x] end-to-end smoke test in branch CI - [x] reviewed and approved by reviewers Context: this is the first step toward automated quality gating for prompt regressions called out in ENG-1421 and will allow the team to catch regressions from model rollouts and prompt edits earlier in the development cycle. See linked Linear tasks for follow-ups to add richer metric types and triage automation.

review_comments: Ethan Cole: Can we avoid pulling full model weights in the CI runner? Suggest using the lightweight test-registry container (response: updated workflow to fetch model-metadata and a small test artifact; heavy weights are not pulled).

Marina Petrov: Thresholds look tight for smaller families; can we add a per-family scaling factor? (response: added family-level overrides in prompt_catalog and documented guidance in docs/eval/ci-gating.md).

Samir Gupta: baseline_store needs retries for eventual consistency with S3, and clearer error codes. (response: added exponential backoff + normalized error messages; added unit tests to cover transient S3 failures).
Ethan Cole: please add a short smoke test that runs in <10 minutes for PR to avoid blocking. (response: added tests/e2e/test_eval_smoke.py that runs a 3-prompt subset and verifies gating path).
Marina Petrov: minor nit: follow the repo import ordering in regression_gate.py. (response: fixed import ordering and ran linter).
merge_summary: Merged by squash-merge after approvals. Maintainer merge on 2026-01-07; commit message: 'eval-harness: prompt-set regression CI gating and baseline helpers'
release_notes: Add CI gating for prompt-set regressions: new workflow, evaluation gating script, baseline store helpers, and prompt-catalog tagging. This enables automated blocking of merges when core prompt quality drops beyond thresholds.
notes_for_followup: Next work: allow dynamic baseline updates via automated analysis (ENG-1430), add additional metric types (e.g., calibrated likelihood deltas), and extend the gating UI in Redwood Console to show failing prompts per PR.
